title: Quick Saturday Update: Bitcoin Holds. Clarity Crumbles.
transcript_text: Saturday mornings are interesting because we get to see what the institutions and big money is doing and we see is that Bitcoin is struggling at 95K. It went down almost to 93 and bounced right back up so struggling and then we all see Ethereum doing actually pretty well. 3333.3 and both which is interesting had sell-offs last night at around 11.51 Atlantic time. Now what that means is of course everything gets a shutdown for the weekend. People are taking profits and doing what they do as they start to sell off. Also what we see now is that it's kind of interesting and bullish is that the 10-year treasuries are at a four-month high of 4.23% and when treasuries go up, there's a 4-month high, that's good for them and people want to get that into the free money. Now people will say well that doesn't really matter because you know it's still higher than inflation or lower than inflation which is true but when you get 10-year treasuries a lot of the old money get into it because they don't want to get into anything too risky. So even with that, Bitcoin still held its own and said 95K is not too bad. Gold and silver, hit all time highs, money rotates into that, can't help it. Open interest is actually down so that means that there's a little bit of a reset as everybody gets liquidated which is also good and right now we're stuck between the 50-week and a hundred week some moving average. Meet personally, I'd like to see it go below 200 week moving average so I can load up but this is where we're at and around the 20 week mark or 20 week moving average, that's where we get to see 101K for Bitcoin. Once that happens you're gonna see more sell-offs I believe so I'm just waiting for the 200-week drawdown and then lastly the Trump administration is not too happy with Brian Armstrong and Coinbase as they have removed their support for the Clarity Act and we've covered this at nauseam and I just don't think it's gonna pass. People will tell you that's gonna pass but I don't think it's gonna actually happen and it kind of feels like right now it's a repeat from 2022 where we see that there's talk about this big thing that's gonna move everything. We just get this one big thing and things will be great. Last time there was a ETF. We got the ETF but that was in 2024. 2022 things are to just keep sliding down. I think it's the same thing that's going on with this Clarity Act and as a reminder I always see it as there's four pillars for us to get past everything. Equity, economic factors, regulations and institutions. Once we get all those four together everything's good. Problem is right now if regulations, Clarity Act, I don't think it's gonna happen and in the mid-term year when the Democrats and the Republicans are fighting, guess what happens? Dills don't get past so we'll see what happens maybe I'm wrong. That's the quick Saturday update.
